primary_source.used: For a finite connected etale degree-e cover of A1 over algebraically closed characteristic-zero constants, projective completion and ramification only over infinity give 2g-2=-e-b, hence e=b=1.
primary_source.scope_boundary: Only the displayed characteristic-zero curve formula and its finite-cover consequence are used here. QFC1 retains the general affine-space covering source and Fitting/differentials proof dependencies.

written_arguments: Exact positional R centralizer embeds in a Laurent scalar one-variable Ore algebra by the finite quantum chart and explicit inverse.
The unimodular global differential frame B,D0 gives a unique finite PBW normal form, hence the exact global Ore presentation of Cent(R); its R=0 fiber is A1 times the Laurent Weyl algebra.
Order-semigroup subtraction gives centralizer module finiteness over C[S] for every positive-order S, without an order cutoff or leading-coefficient unit assumption.
The localized classical centralizer K(r)[s], h-Gauss ring and QFC1 give local polynomiality without importing Schur commutativity.
Highest-order coefficient comparison descends K(r)((h))[S] to K((h))(r)[S].
Actual S-mates specialize at every irreducible r-divisor and force transcendence even at operator-order drops; denominator saturation gives global K((h))[R,S].
Actual generic mates of both positions can be made integral and matched to the prescribed classical tuple, after which finite polynomial curvature integration supplies a full bounded lift.
